run_torchvision_to_d2_conversion: run the script to convert a torchvision ResNet .pth model file to Detectron2 .pkl format
convert_resnet_weights: convert torchvision ResNet50 pretrained weights from .pth to Detectron2 compatible .pkl format
rename_layer_keys: rename torchvision layer keys like layer1 to res2 and bn1 to conv1.norm for Detectron2
export_numpy_weights: export model weights as numpy arrays and save to a pickle file with matching heuristics metadata
check_unconverted_keys: check and print any model keys that were not converted during the torchvision to Detectron2 conversion
